name: ecommerce-scraper
description: Scrape products from any e-commerce site. Auto detects 14 major marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Etsy, AliExpress, Best Buy, Costco, Wayfair, Home Depot, IKEA, Zalando, ASOS, Shopify) with a JSON-LD primary parser that covers most other retailers. Pricing, stock, ratings, variants, images, AI summaries. Pay per row.
